race.description: Become A Qjc Member Today Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: SANBINA (10) won her maiden two back over 1400m then stepped up to the mile at Tamworth last start and went very close to making it two on the trot. Given a 32-day freshen-up since that last effort. Needs a pinch of luck from a wide gate but a strong tempo should string the field out. Happy to stick. MEMPHIS BLUE (3) finally collected his maiden win two runs ago over this distance at Tamworth. Found the 2200m at Scone last time beyond him. Deserves another chance back to this trip with blinkers on for the first time. JUPITER HILLS (8) tried hard but just came up short in a moderate Class 1 over the mile at Coonabarabran recently. Needs to go up a level but the addition of shades could do the trick. IMMORTAL ROSE (7) won her maiden here over 1450m last time out. Room for further improvement. MAJOR LIGHTNING (2) has disappointed this prep but deserves another chance with the blinkers being applied for the first time.
